commons:169657316.summary: Against a pale, open ground, Christ, labelled IHC XPC and followed by his disciples, stretches out his hand toward a man who holds up his withered hand as it is restored. At the left a group of men looks on, probably the scribes and Pharisees who watched to see whether Jesus would heal on the Sabbath. The miniature's clear gestures and spacious setting are typical of the narrative art of Reichenau.
facts: The Codex Egberti is a Gospel book illuminated in the scriptorium of Reichenau Abbey for Egbert of Trier (d. 993), after whom it is named.
It is still kept in Trier, in the city library (Stadtbibliothek Weberbach), as Cod. 24.
commons:169657316.notes: Folio not confirmed. Wikipedia calls Egbert bishop of Trier (980–993). The label over the left group is only partly legible in the image.
